simple.meaning: הֶגֶה (hegeh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a muttering (in sighing, thought, or as thunder).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: הֶגֶה (H1899) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 37:2, with occurrences in Job, Psalms, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הֶגֶה (H1899) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in הֶגֶה (H1899) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: הֶגֶה (hegeh) / H1899 is traced through Job 37:2, Psalms 90:9, Ezekiel 2:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a muttering (in sighing, thought, or as thunder)
definitions.full: H1899. hegeh הֶ֫גֶה noun masculine Job 37:2 a rumbling, growling, moaning : — ׳ה absolute Ezek 2:10 2 t.; — 1 a rumbling, growling sound ׳וְה יֵצֵא מִמִּיו Job 37:2 of thunder, as sound going forth from God's mouth. 2 a moaning וָה ׳קִינִים וָהִי Ezek 2:10 lamentations and moaning and woe . 3 a sigh or moan , as transient, כְמוֺהֶֿ֑גֶה שָׁנֵינוּ כִּלִּינוּ Psa 90:9 we bring our years to an end as a sign , i.e. a fleeting sound (compare RVm VB).

occurrences.englishText: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice,
For all our days have passed away in your wrath.
He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.
